translated_title: Mexico City: Rents Rose More Than Double Inflation in a Year
original_title: CDMX: aumentaron las rentas más del doble de la inflación en un año
author: Mara Ximena Pérez and Nayelli Ramírez Bautista
meta_description: Four months after a stalled initiative to cap rent hikes, a two-bedroom in the capital now averages 21,921 pesos a month—nearly 70 days of minimum wage.
